answer.reasoning: The group problem has two parts: the request-scoped ctx used at four goroutine sites (Create, Delete, Update, DeleteCollection), and the legacy error no longer being logged. That gives five facets. Labeler 2 added two more. F6, the lost synchronous guarantee, is just a consequence of the same ctx and async defect, not a separate edit. F7, out-of-order commits, appears in only one member as a side remark and is not part of the group's problem. So those two facets wrongly made complete members look incomplete. s_0fa90f2c names all four goroutine ranges (50-57, 108-114, 134-141, 161-167), says the goroutine builds its timeout from the request ctx, and says the error is 'only recorded in a metric with no log'. It covers all five. s_7e8b6adf names lines 51, 110, 135 and 163 but never mentions the missing log, so it is incomplete. s_b0ebef03 names all four locations and states the error 'is no longer logged', so it covers all five.
